insight.headline: OrderCreate Mutation
insight.what_changed: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput, allowing multiple tracking numbers to be attached to a fulfillment when importing orders. This change is available in the GraphQL Admin API.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderCreate mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new trackingNumbers field. This field allows for multiple tracking numbers to be attached to a fulfillment, providing more flexibility and accuracy in order tracking. When using this field, ensure that the tracking numbers are correctly formatted and associated with the correct fulfillment. Additionally, be aware that this change may require updates to existing fulfillment workflows and order management systems.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and detailed order tracking, as multiple tracking numbers can now be associated with a single fulfillment. This change can help improve the overall shipping and fulfillment experience for merchants and their customers.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it provides more flexibility and accuracy in order tracking, which is essential for merchants and their customers. By supporting multiple tracking numbers, Shopify is improving the overall fulfillment experience and helping merchants to better manage their orders.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.4
updates.summary: Hydrogen CLI now supports a new flag --javascript-origin to override the default --dev-origin for customer account push. Local Hydrogen CLI discovery has also been fixed.

updates.title: @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.2
updates.summary: MiniOxygen now supports HTTP/2 requests in Vite request conversion, enhancing performance.

updates.title: @shopify/hydrogen@2026.4.5
updates.summary: Hydrogen customer account login recovery has been improved when switching browser contexts or opening multiple login tabs, with OAuth state values now using cryptographically secure randomness.

updates.title: skeleton@2026.4.6
updates.summary: Newly scaffolded storefronts now recommend the Shopify AI Toolkit, and dependencies have been updated.

updates.title: @shopify/create-hydrogen@5.0.39
updates.summary: The create-hydrogen package now recommends the Shopify AI Toolkit in newly scaffolded storefronts.

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants.
The CLI now serves UI extension source maps during app development, enhancing debugging capabilities.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, including updating cart attributes and firing a new event when an attributes update is initiated.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Inventory holds for draft orders, transfers, and shipments are being consolidated from reserved to committed, enhancing inventory management.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP tools are now exposed in online stores, allowing AI agents to search catalogs, manage carts, and go to checkout on behalf of shoppers.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing deployment of Hydrogen storefronts from dev stores.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, allowing attachment of multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders.

recap.headline: Hydrogen updates and ShopifyQL expansion highlight the week

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Multiple Hydrogen-related packages received updates, including @shopify/cli-hydrogen, @shopify/mini-oxygen, @shopify/hydrogen, and @shopify/create-hydrogen, with improvements such as new flags, HTTP/2 support, and enhanced security. The skeleton package also saw updates, including a recommendation for the Shopify AI Toolkit in new storefronts.

themes.title: ShopifyQL Expansion
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query this data on behalf of authorized merchants using the existing ShopifyQL infrastructure.

actions.text: Review and update Hydrogen projects to utilize the latest packages and features
